**What their page says:** 
The programs are free and run in Halton Hills for children from birth to their 6th birthday and their parents or caregivers.
 
They are offered on weekdays, weekends and evenings, in person as drop-in or registered programs, and online.
 One location is 
the Acton Halton Hills Public Library at 17 River Street, Acton, (905) 873-2681.
 The page also lists a Georgetown location.

**Left blank on purpose:** `when`, `price` and `registration`.
- The page points to a "Current Schedule" further down. The search returned only the top of the page, so I could not read the day or time of any drop-in session.
- I did not read the page's full text, so I did not fill in the schedule myself.
- The page calls the programs free, so no price is listed.

**What I left out:**
- **Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre preschool drop-in:** it costs $15 per parent, so it is not free. Its posted dates also look like last season's.
- **Library storytimes:** the only listings I found were for July 2026, so they are stale for now.
- **Parent & Tot skating:** this is Halton Hills Recreation. It is paid (adult $4.00, child $2.50), and I found no times.
- **Halton Region "Kids & Me" drop-in groups:** I only saw these on a directory listing. I could not tie them to a Halton Hills location.
